pre_registration.decision_rule: gpt-6-luna is capable for a seat if the 95% lower bound of its paired primary-metric difference from gpt-6.1-sol is at least -0.05
pre_registration.confidence_method: percentile bootstrap of matched fixture items, 10000 draws, seed 1729; recompute each role's primary metric within each draw
pre_registration.negative_control: pairing each low-cost output with a shuffled full-model output of the same role must give a paired-difference interval containing zero

refine.reason: One generation and one held-out judge call per model and item; cap their combined cost while covering multiple domains.

docs.reason: One generation and one held-out rubric call per model and item; cap the expensive judge.

breaker-names.reason: Retain opportunities for verdict flips while bounding production review prompts.

breaker-docs.reason: Retain opportunities for verdict flips while bounding one docs review call per item.

classifier.reason: Cover more gold paths because classification runs in batches and has no held-out judge.
